_readme: Every texture key the game expects. Add a `file` (relative to /assets) to replace a placeholder; keys without a file are generated in code by src/placeholders/textures.ts. Character sheets must be a single row of 6 frames: 0-1 idle, 2-5 walk cycle. Theo is 64x96 per frame and Lucy 48x72 so they read at true scale against the 640x400 rooms.

intro_house_cutout._note: house and trees with the sky transparent; clouds drift behind it on the title screen

theo_front._note: south-facing Theo used for the wake-up-in-bed intro

bed_empty._note: the bedroom art has no bed of its own; this is always drawn over it at BED_POS

bed_asleep._note: wake-up intro: the same bed with Theo asleep in it

bed_sit._note: wake-up intro: the same bed with Theo sitting up yawning

gag_frog._note: breakfast gag: hops out of a kitchen cupboard and away across the floor; drawn facing left

net_low._note: the little hoop's rim and net cut out of bg_0 (scripts: see art/pixellab/sport_court.md); drawn over a ball dropping through at HOOPS[].net

net_mid._note: the medium hoop's rim and net cut out of bg_0

net_high._note: the tall hoop's rim and net cut out of bg_0

playhouse_window_frame._note: the side window's frame and mullions, drawn over the bird that passes the panes

stomp_launcher._note: the launcher without its rocket, standing on the lawn at LAUNCHER.at (feet); tube top and pad are measured into StompRocketController

rocket_flying._note: the foam rocket, upright, drawn on the tube and flown; the backpack icon is scaled up if this is missing

sky_kite._note: stomp rocket flight: drifts across at 50 m, the first thing the rocket passes

sky_plane._note: stomp rocket flight: crosses the sky at 100 m

sky_satellite._note: stomp rocket flight: hangs at 150 m with a blinking red light drawn in code

sky_ufo._note: stomp rocket flight: wobbles across at 200 m

sky_moon._note: stomp rocket flight: hangs at 250 m

backyard_sky._note: everything in the top band that is not sky, drawn over the drifting clouds and birds

garage_lamp._note: the hanging cage lamp, cut out so it can sway; the ceiling was painted across behind it in the garage art

glow._note: soft warm light under the garage lamp

bg_slide._note: the slide ride: the view down the slide from its top platform; the bed's geometry is measured into SLIDE in src/puzzles/slide.ts

obstacle_leaf._note: a pile of autumn leaves on the slide

obstacle_mud._note: a mud splat on the slide

bg_foyer._note: the ending: the front hall, seen from inside the house; positions in src/data/foyer.ts

parents._note: Mom and Dad side by side, feet on the bottom edge, drawn at FOYER.parents in the ending

toy_track._note: the toy race track on the bedroom carpet, drawn at TRACK.at; clicking it starts the race

bg_race_0._note: the race mini-game: the carpet close-up (pixellab, art/pixellab/raw/race_floor_seed31.png) with the track painted on by scripts/race_track.py from src/puzzles/race-track.json

race_loop_front._note: the loop-the-loop's near rail alone, drawn over the car while it is in the loop; written by scripts/race_track.py

car_top._note: the race car from above, pointing right; turned to follow the track

car_side._note: the race car side-on, pointing right; flipped and turned round the loop

booster_icon._note: the Boost button's picture in the race mini-game; a code-drawn box stands in when it is missing

bg_memory_0._note: the garage memory game: a wall of four empty shelves; box positions in SHELVES in src/scenes/MemoryScene.ts

box_closed._note: a taped-shut cardboard box, drawn standing on a shelf (origin bottom-centre)

box_open._note: the same box with its flaps open; the thing inside is drawn over it

mem_hammer._note: a thing in Dad's boxes, for the memory game

mem_wrench._note: a thing in Dad's boxes, for the memory game

mem_paint._note: a thing in Dad's boxes, for the memory game

mem_flashlight._note: a thing in Dad's boxes, for the memory game

mem_ball._note: a thing in Dad's boxes, for the memory game

mem_tape._note: a thing in Dad's boxes, for the memory game

mem_bulb._note: a thing in Dad's boxes, for the memory game

mem_can._note: a thing in Dad's boxes, for the memory game

bg_tea_0._note: the tea party: the playhouse table close up; where things stand is TABLE in src/scenes/TeaScene.ts

teapot._note: one pink teapot, drawn at two sizes for the pots that pour three and two

teacup_empty._note: the teacup empty; all four share one silhouette

teacup_partial._note: the teacup part way filled (short of its mark); all the cups share one silhouette

teacup_full._note: the teacup filled exactly to its mark

teacup_over._note: the teacup overfilled: tea over the rim, down the sides and on the saucer; shown from the spill until the level resets

lucy_clap._note: hands apart then together; played when Theo pockets something and Lucy is with him

theo_shoot._note: hoop game: turned away toward the hoops, holding the ball up (frame 0), then arms up after the release with no ball (frame 1); the thrown ball is its own object

theo_slide._note: seen from behind, sitting: hands down, then arms up; looped on the slide ride

bird._note: a small bird in flight, wings up then down; flocks over the backyard and court, one passes the playhouse window

butterfly._note: wings open, then the same frame squashed to half width for the closed beat

leaf._note: three autumn leaves for the playground and the slide ride

robin._note: the robin cut out of the lawn art (the lawn was patched behind it); it hops and pecks by tilting. A 3-frame sheet (standing, hopping, pecking) would be used instead if one is dropped in

tv_golf._note: the family room television's golf broadcast, three moments of a putt, cropped to the picture inside the bezel (x 336-423, y 128-175)

lucy_slide._note: seen from behind, sitting: hands down, then arms up; looped on the slide ride

theo_back._note: seen from behind, for the ending: 0 standing, 1-6 running cycle, 7 arms out (take-off), 8 arms up (top of a jump)

lucy_back._note: seen from behind, for the ending: 0 standing, 1-6 running cycle, 7 arms out (take-off), 8 arms up (top of a jump)
